On January 14th, Peter and Samantha continued their discussions about the AI project at Caroline's Café, deciding to bring treats for stray animals and seeds for the community garden. They agreed to meet again the next day at 3 PM. Peter met with Diego at a restaurant and extended the meetings to include others, scheduling a meeting at Caroline's Café next Wednesday at 3 PM, where Diego would bring vegan street tacos. Peter invited Noor, Leo, and Mei to the meeting, and they decided to make it a regular tradition.

In addition, Peter talked to Mei at a restaurant on January 14th at 8 AM. They discussed the AI project and agreed to have regular meetings every Friday at 2 PM at the same restaurant.
